what_it_does: This tool helps developers understand and fix slow data access in programs by analyzing how the CPU's fast temporary memory (cache) stores and retrieves data. It tracks when cache entries are evicted (thrown out to make room), measures how well the program reuses recent data (temporal locality) and accesses nearby data together (spatial locality), and categorizes why data lookups miss the cache. It visualizes these complex interactions as a graph to help identify bottlenecks.
